text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Heading home after a day out,
Manhattan Cafe
and I reach the
academy gates when...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Would you like some coffee after this?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: There's a roast I'd really like you to try...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Come with me... and follow very closely.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe takes me to her own
private
space on the academy grounds.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Here's the roast I mentioned...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe gestures to a
transparent glass
jar with some unground
coffee beans inside.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
These beans are from my coffee plant... I
roasted
them myself...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It takes around... three years for it to
bear fruit.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
And you can only harvest the cherries
once a
year...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
These are from the coffee plant she grew
herself.
With all the hard work she put
into harvesting
them, they're practically
priceless.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...It's because it's precious that I want
you to try
it.
choice_data_list: ……こんな貴重なもの、いいのか？
choice_data_list_en: ...Are you sure I can have something so valuable?
...Are you sure I can have something so valuable?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I roasted the beans to suit your tastes... I
think
you'll like it.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: So...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Let's have some, together.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'll brew it right away... Please wait a
moment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sounds of Manhattan Cafe brewing
the
coffee echo quietly throughout the
room...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
My parents grow their own plants as
well... Once a
year, we get together and
enjoy the coffee...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Our yearly custom always reminds me of
a
moonlit night... Kind and comforting...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I wanted you to experience that too...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Thank you for waiting. Here you are.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take a sip of the freshly brewed coffee.
The
flavor and warmth seep through my
body.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sit with Manhattan Cafe for a while as
we both
savor the coffee in silence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We finish our drinks without saying a
single word
to each other. Then, while
the aftertaste still
lingers...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...How was it?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...How was it?
choice_data_list: こんな美味しいコーヒー初めてだ
こんな美味しいコーヒー初めて
素敵な時間をありがとう
俺もカフェに、コーヒーを淹れてあげたい
私もカフェに、コーヒーを淹れてあげたい
choice_data_list_en: I've never had coffee this delicious before.
I've never had coffee this delicious before.
Thank you for the wonderful time.
I want to brew some coffee for Cafe too.
I want to brew some coffee for Cafe, too.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...You're exaggerating.
choice_data_list: こんな美味しいコーヒー初めてだ
こんな美味しいコーヒー初めて
素敵な時間をありがとう
俺もカフェに、コーヒーを淹れてあげたい
私もカフェに、コーヒーを淹れてあげたい
choice_data_list_en: I've never had coffee this delicious before.
I've never had coffee this delicious before.
Thank you for the wonderful time.
I want to brew some coffee for Cafe too.
I want to brew some coffee for Cafe, too.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I feel the same way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The time I spent enjoying the coffee
tonight was
richer than a thousand words
could describe. I
feel like its taste will
stay with me forever.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...No, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I'm truly grateful...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Would...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Would you mind... if we met up next
year...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: And had coffee together again?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
choice_data_list: 来年も、再来年も、また飲もう
choice_data_list_en: Let's drink together again next year, and the year after that.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Right.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Next year... and the year after that...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I enjoy the rest of the evening while
wondering
what the coffee we share
next year will taste like.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: In that case...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
How about growing a coffee plant with
me?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It'll take more than three years for it to
fully
grow, but...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.
choice_data_list: その時を楽しみにして頑張るよ
choice_data_list_en: I'll work hard and look forward to that moment.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Well, even if that day won't come for
quite some
time...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to it too...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The coffee we have then will taste
better than
today's. I just know it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Together, the two of us spend some time

picturing an even richer and more
aromatic
future.
